title.narrative: SALAR inception 2017: Basic services in Syria's neighbouring countries
SKL förberdande 2017: samhällstjänster i Syriens grannländer:

description.narrative: SKL avser genomföra en förberedande insats som inledning till ett eventuellt längre program i Libanon och Turkiet. Under denna inledningsfas planerar SKL inkomma med en ansökan till Sida om finansiering för ett flerårigt program. Syftet med insatsen i det längre perspektivet är att verka för förbättrad lokal förvaltning av grundläggande samhällstjänster och en starkare sammanhållning (mellan flyktingar och lokalbefolkning) på lokal nivå i Libanon och Turkiet.

SKL intends to carry out a preparatory effort as an introduction to a possible longer program in Lebanon and Turkey. During this initial plan, SKL will submit an application to Sida for funding for a multiannual program. The aim of the efforts in the longer perspective is to promote improved local governance of basic social services and stronger cohesion (between refugees and locals) at local level in Lebanon and Turkey.

sector.narrative: Decentralisation and support to subnational government

description.narrative: Within the framework of Sweden's Regional Strategy for the Syria Crisis 2016-2020, the Swedish Association of Local Authorities and Regions (SALAR) through its affiliate SKL International carried out a Feasibility study on resilience in local governance in Syria's neighbours. This work was conducted between August 2016 and April 2017 in Turkey , Lebanon and Jordan. As a result from this study, it was decided to design a project for Turkey and Lebanon starting with an Inception phase to design the intervention. The current project (Inception phase) was agreed between Sida and SALAR to develop a full project proposal. The inception phase was carried out from December 2017 to November 2018 and the full proposal was assessed and approved by the Embassy of Sweden of Beirut. The result of the inception phase is the intervention programme itself which successfully started during 2019 (Contribution 11573). The Embassy of Sweden in Beirut (EoS) assesses the project results as achieved.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
